title: ProofSpec
description: The specification of one proof effort: its scope identity, who opened it, and the research claims it targets. The proof_id is the namespace every object of the effort is scoped under (commit gate rule), so it is assigned before any content exists.

proof_id.description: Scope root, e.g. 'p1'. Not allocator-issued: everything else is scoped under it.

actor.description: Who opened the proof; immutable after creation.
